description: This Swift source file defines the MotionService class which implements motion activity and pedometer data retrieval using iOS CoreMotion APIs, including permission checks, data querying, and result formatting.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: A class responsible for retrieving motion activities and pedometer data from iOS device sensors.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified time range, returning an array of activity entries.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Retrieves pedometer data such as steps, distance, and floors within a specified time range.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Helps parse ISO8601 date strings into Date objects, defaulting to start of day and current date if inputs are nil.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum value to a string representation.
